findings.message: PBO = 0.70 across 52 configurations: the in-sample winner lands below the out-of-sample median in 70% of the 12,870 splits.
52 trials in 'futures-trend' were evaluated on their test window; out-of-sample p-values are Holm-adjusted for that.

scorecard.label: Out-of-sample significance (Holm-adjusted)
scorecard.note: p = 0.793 raw, adjusted for 52 trials evaluated on the test window. Informational here: the sealed holdout is this experiment's confirmatory test.

scorecard.label: Deflated Sharpe ratio (in-sample)
scorecard.note: In-sample Sharpe 0.38 against an expected best-of-18.8 noise Sharpe of 0.27.

scorecard.label: Positive in volatility regimes
scorecard.note: Share of low/mid/high volatility regimes with a positive Sharpe.

scorecard.label: Sharpe with the 1% best and worst periods trimmed
Sealed holdout test (Bonferroni over looks)
scorecard.note: Holdout Sharpe 0.45, p = 0.154; this was look 3 of 3 allowed, so p x 3 = 0.463.

report.verdict_reason: No convincing edge; fails: deflated sharpe ratio (in-sample), probability of backtest overfitting (family), out-of-sample / in-sample sharpe, sealed holdout test (bonferroni over looks), no critical research-hygiene warnings.
